description: Update an existing Sisense user identified by their email address.

user_email.description: Email address of the user to update (used to locate the user).

email.description: New email address for the user

user_data.description: Dictionary of fields to update. Only include fields you want to change. Supported fields ---------------- - email : str Update the user's email address. - userName : str Update the user's username/login name. - firstName : str Update the user's first name. - lastName : str Update the user's last name. - role : str Role name (e.g., "viewer", "designer"). This is resolved to ``roleId`` before sending the API request. - groups : list[str] List of group names to apply. Group names are resolved to group IDs before sending the API request. If ``groups`` is explicitly provided as an empty list (``[]``), group memberships are cleared (tenant defaults may still apply).
